description.narrative: The Growth Research Platform (GRP) is a new initiative led by the Centre for Economic Policy Research (CEPR), focused on understanding and addressing the challenges faced by economies in developing countries. The platform is funded by the Foreign, Commonwealth, and Development Office (FCDO) and incorporates the research of the Private Enterprise Development in Low-Income Countries (PEDL), Structural Transformation and Economic Growth (STEG), and Reducing Conflict and Improving Performance in the Economy (ReCIPE) programmes, alongside the synthesising and dissemination work of VoxDev.
